['H&M Hennes & Mauritz B.V. & Co. KG '].company_description: H&M Hennes & Mauritz B.V. & Co. KG is a Swedish clothing retailer founded in 1947. The company operates in the fashion retail industry and offers a wide range of clothing and accessories for men, women, and children.
